svg.title: RAG Workflow Lab - target pipeline from user question to final answer
svg.desc: Target design: router, Simple, Enhanced and Agentic RAG, Enhanced evidence check, answer context, generation, validation, offline data layer and tracing. Solid boxes are built; dashed boxes are planned. Updated 27 November 2026.
svg.text: Target pipeline: from user question to final answer
How the finished system answers one question | Target design, updated 27 November 2026
Enhanced RAG - hybrid search, reranking, evidence check, tools
Agentic RAG - the LLM chooses the next tool (LangGraph)
Nomic query embedding + pgvector cosine search
Top 5 chunks go to the answer
One retrieval pass; no hybrid search, reranking or tools
Nomic Embed Text v1.5, local CPU
Local model on Apple MPS, float16
Dev set, full evidence in top 5:
Python rules decide when to inspect
the frozen sandbox DB: schema, indexes
Conditions, contracts and order not set.
1. Score gate: best Qwen score >= 0.95, else stop with no API call
2. Luna sufficiency check: sufficient / partial / insufficient,
with exact source quotes verified in Python
Sufficient -> answer context; otherwise fixed "insufficient evidence"
Repeat within iteration and time limits; limits not decided yet
Chunks labelled S1 ... S5, with source IDs and URLs
Tool results added when a tool was used (planned)
Final token budget not decided yet
gpt-6-luna via the OpenAI Responses API
Prompt answer_v1, reasoning none, max 1000 output tokens
Same model and prompt in every workflow
Today: answer is completed and nonempty
Planned: every citation label is valid
Undecided: are claims supported by the sources?
do not support an answer (Enhanced: no answer call)
PREPARED OFFLINE - SHARED BY EVERY WORKFLOW
14 sources: 8 PostgreSQL 18 docs + 6 synthetic Atlas docs
Parsed into 151 chunks (target 512 / max 1024 tokens, no overlap)
Nomic vectors and chunk text in PostgreSQL + pgvector
Fixed tables and indexes for tool questions
Read-only; identical state for every run
Nomic Embed Text v1.5 - embeddings, local CPU
gpt-6-luna - evidence check + answers, hosted API
Tracing - every question is one trace and every step one span, stored in PostgreSQL
Records prompts, chunk IDs and ranks, scores, decisions, answer, tokens, time and errors. Built: retrieval, reranking, evidence-check and LLM spans. Planned: router, DB-tool and validator spans.

Target design, not a measured result. Router, Agentic control, DB tools and shared validator are not built; Enhanced answers are offline-tested, with no live end-to-end run yet. 82 -> 92 is retrieval evidence, not answer accuracy.
Sources: METHOD_DESIGN, STATUS, HANDOFF, QWEN_RERANKER_COMPARISON, RERANKER_THRESHOLD_REVIEW | 0.95 is a development cutoff, not a final thesis policy
